view.scene_description: A low-angle shot inside a large warehouse with high shelves stocked with boxes and red crates. Workers in red and black uniforms move through aisles. Signs indicate sections like 'FLEISCH 2' and 'FLEISCH 3'. The floor is concrete, and lighting comes from overhead fixtures. Motion blur suggests active movement.

objects.label: person walking
objects.observation: A person in motion, wearing dark pants and a red-and-black jacket, strides across the foreground. Their legs and arms show motion blur. They appear to be walking toward the right side of the frame. No clear contact with objects except possibly the floor.

objects.label: red plastic crates
objects.observation: Stacked red plastic crates sit on a gray pallet near the center-right. Some are stacked vertically, others lie horizontally. They are positioned under a metal shelf structure. A worker stands nearby, partially obscured by the crates.

objects.label: warehouse shelving
objects.observation: Metal shelving units line both sides of the aisle, filled with cardboard boxes and red crates. Yellow safety rails run along the top edges. Signs like 'FLEISCH 2' are mounted on the shelves. The shelves extend into the background, creating depth.

objects.label: cardboard boxes
objects.observation: Numerous brown cardboard boxes are stacked on pallets and shelves throughout the scene. Some have white labels. They are arranged in orderly piles, mostly on the left and center-left. Boxes are supported by wooden or metal pallets.

objects.label: worker in background
objects.observation: A second worker in a red shirt and black pants stands near the right-side shelving, partially obscured by red crates. They appear to be handling items or inspecting shelves. Their position is behind the main subject and slightly to the right.

objects.label: overhead lights
objects.observation: Bright fluorescent lights hang from the ceiling in a linear pattern along the right side of the aisle. They illuminate the scene evenly, casting minimal shadows. Lights are suspended by wires or fixtures not clearly visible.

State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):

Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.
